item.title: Version 1.1.26
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.26

  • Split Anomaly Sanitization: Automatically detects and filters unadjusted split cliffs and double-adjusted split pockets from historical chart data (e.g. 1489.T ATH calculation).
  • Cross-Market Cache Self-Healing: Automatically detects and purges stale history cache when a severe price scale mismatch occurs with the live quote (e.g. US NET vs HNX NET).
  • Watchlist ATH & Metric Accuracy: Ensures From ATH, 3M, 6M, and YTD performance metrics consistently reflect clean single-market price series.
